description: Defines classes and enums related to warning reporting categories, including handling of plugin state changes and message types for long operations.

classes.name: TooLongPluginState
classes.description: Represents the state of a plugin with analysis, serialization, deserialization, and string conversion functionalities.

classes.name: TooLongInvokeMessage
classes.description: Represents a message for long invocation detection with analysis, serialization, deserialization, and string conversion functionalities.

methods.name: Analyze
methods.description: Analyzes input data to set internal state based on message type or plugin state change.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes internal data into a buffer for transmission or storage.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes data from a buffer to restore internal state.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Converts internal data to a human-readable string format.
